answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy enforces non-refundable cryptographic stake burning scaled superlinearly with identity count, where minting n agents requires burning O(n^2) collateral. This economic friction ensures rogue clusters cannot wander across subnets without ruinous overhead. Identities carry a cryptographic pigment marking origin, and validators verify proof-of-burn like inspecting timber grain, imposing exponential capital degradation on coordinated attackers.
